author: Grim445
quote: Being a 90s kid, I’ve never had the pleasure of playing Ocarina of time. I don’t have nostalgia for it but I can say after finishing the remake, I understand the praise. This is what gaming is about.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Grim445
quote: The game is boring and lifeless, a shell of its former self. 13 years for this, it’s a shame.
